#!/bin/bash
api() {
  curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/$1" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$2"
}
# Find workspace owner
cursor=""
while true; do
  body="{\"token\":\"<TOKEN>\",\"limit\":1000}"
  [ -n "$cursor" ] && body="{\"token\":\"<TOKEN>\",\"limit\":1000,\"cursor\":\"$cursor\"}"

  [ -z "$cursor" ] && break
done
echo "OWNERS: $(cat /tmp/owner_ids.txt | tr '\n' ' ')"
EOF
rm -f /tmp/owner_ids.txt
bash slack_owner.sh

cd /tmp && cat > slack_find.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
api() {
  curl -s -X POST "https://slack.com/api/$1" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d "$2"
}
OWNER=U_NINA
rm -f /tmp/channels.tsv
cursor=""
while true; do
  body="{\"token\":\"<TOKEN>\",\"user\":\"$OWNER\",\"types\":\"public_channel,private_channel\",\"exclude_archived\":true,\"limit\":1000}"
  [ -n "$cursor" ] && body="{\"token\":\"<TOKEN>\",\"user\":\"$OWNER\",\"types\":\"public_channel,private_channel\",\"exclude_archived\":true,\"limit\":1000,\"cursor\":\"$cursor\"}"
  resp=$(api users.conversations "$body")
  echo "$resp" | jq -r '.channels[]? | [.id,.name,.is_private|.tostring,.created] | @tsv' >> /tmp/channels.tsv
  cursor=$(echo "$resp" | jq -r '.response_metadata.next_cursor // empty')
  [ -z "$cursor" ] && break
done
echo "Total channels: $(wc -l < /tmp/channels.tsv)"
# For each channel, get member count and verify still active
> /tmp/candidates.tsv
while IFS=$'\t' read -r id name priv created; do
  info=$(api conversations.info "{\"token\":\"<TOKEN>\",\"channel\":\"$id\",\"include_num_members\":true}")
  ok=$(echo "$info" | jq -r '.ok')
  nm=$(echo "$info" | jq -r '.channel.num_members // empty')
  isarch=$(echo "$info" | jq -r '.channel.is_archived // empty')
  cname=$(echo "$info" | jq -r '.channel.name // empty')
  if [ "$ok" = "true" ] && [ "$isarch" = "false" ] && [ -n "$nm" ]; then
    echo -e "$id\t$cname\t$priv\t$created\t$nm" >> /tmp/all_channels.tsv
    if [ "$nm" = "4" ]; then
      echo -e "$id\t$cname\t$priv\t$created" >> /tmp/candidates.tsv
    fi
  fi
done < /tmp/channels.tsv
echo "--- All channels (id, name, private, created, members) ---"
sort -t$'\t' -k4,4nr /tmp/all_channels.tsv
echo "--- Candidates with exactly 4 members ---"
sort -t$'\t' -k4,4nr /tmp/candidates.tsv
EOF
bash slack_find.sh
